landing.headline: Run your team hours, leave, and calendar in one place
landing.sub: Multi-company HR for admins and employees — Persian, Armenian, and English.
landing.hoursBody: The week stacks like bricks. Every hour has weight.
landing.leaveBody: Approvals land like a seal. Rest is part of the building.
landing.calendarBody: Seven niches. One of them is for rest.
landing.companyBody: Each company is its own courtyard. People enter with a six-digit token.
landing.adminBody: Presence, pending leave, and the week — in one hall.
landing.employeeBody: Start the day. Pause. End it. Your hours stay in the niche.
landing.trustBody: Persian, Armenian, and English. Multi-company, without noise.
landing.sealBody: Sign in, join with an invite, or raise a new company.
